versions.description_html:
Learn how Fabric Data Pipelines work in Microsoft Fabric. Master ETL vs ELT, control flow, dataflows, and notebooks in clear, jargon-free language.

Your sales file arrives at seven AM, customer records update at eight, and the app data shows up whenever it feels like it, while someone on your team is opening spreadsheets, pressing refresh, fixing columns, and hoping the report tells the same story as yesterday.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • Opening: The Data Is Moving, but Who Is in Control?
  • ETL and ELT: Two Routes for the Same Data
  • What a Fabric Data Pipeline Actually Does
  • Dataflows, Notebooks, and Pipelines: Who Does Which Job?
  • A Beginner Pipeline Story: From Raw File to Usable Table
  • Running the Same Pipeline Without Rebuilding It
  • Monitoring, Errors, and the First Build
  • Conclusion: Build the Routine Before You Automate It

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.

Explore more on M365.FM
